title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第二十五章、包拯的承诺

    一会儿后，蓝香醒了。
    她累极了，声音又小又虚弱，她看着包拯问：“楚珠……你怎么回来了？”
    包拯没有回答，他不知道怎么回答，但是蓝香却像是听到了他的回答，激动地哭了起来：“你说什么？孩子……死了？马超也死了？”
    包拯再一次被震惊：“孩子和马超都死了？”
    “娘娘太可怜了……”蓝香悲伤地哭着，哭着哭着她拉住包拯的手，吃惊地说：“你要……带娘娘出宫？不行，娘娘会死的，他们……他们也会杀了你的……”
    “楚珠带李妃出宫了？”包拯和公孙策同时惊问道。
    “药……”蓝香像是没听见，又着急地在身边翻找起来，她抱起床上的小被子，一把推到包拯手里：“给你……我刚刚在太医院拿了很多治疗外伤的药，给娘娘的……都拿去吧……”
    “蓝香，楚珠把娘娘带出宫了吗？”包拯问。
    “她们走了……蓝香再也见不到她们了……”蓝香流着泪说，她望着门口，像是看着谁在离去。虽然她的样子还是很害怕，但脸上却微微笑了。这一刻，透过她又老又瘦的脸，包拯好像看到了她年轻时的样子，那是一个胆小瘦弱但又善良的女孩的样子。
    包拯深吸一口气问：“蓝香，你为什么没有和她们一起走？”
    蓝香连忙摇头：“太可怕了，不能走，不能走……”
    包拯却明白了，他握着她的手，缓缓地说：“你是担心如果你走了，坏人可能会发现不对，你担心他们来找你，你怕连累娘娘，怕他们发现娘娘还活着，所以你没有走，对吗？但是这么多年你一个人孤独地留在这儿，每天在害怕和担心中度过，不敢说，也不敢问，时间长了你也会生病的。现在你就好好休息吧，事情都交给我，我来处理，我会找到娘娘和楚珠的，你放心吧！”
    蓝香望着包拯，好像终于看清了面前的人，她问：“你是谁？”
    “我是包拯，请相信我，你的苦不会白受，当年的事情也会真相大白的。”包拯慢慢地、温和地说。
    蓝香好像听懂了。她点了点头，闭上眼睛，安心地睡着了。
    包拯和公孙策从屋子里退了出来。门外天空暗沉，树叶飞舞，寒凉的风声和树叶撞击门窗的声音都透着破败和冷清。他们站在院子里，风吹起了他们的衣服，也吹乱了他们的头发。
    “现在有两个人证了，王铁和蓝香，他们都看到过张怀杀人。”公孙策说。
    “走，抓张怀！”包拯说。
fullText.traditional:
第二十五章、包拯的承諾

    一會兒後，藍香醒了。
    她累極了，聲音又小又虛弱，她看著包拯問：“楚珠……你怎麼回來了？”
    包拯沒有回答，他不知道怎麼回答，但是藍香卻像是聽到了他的回答，激動地哭了起來：“你說什麼？孩子……死了？馬超也死了？”
    包拯再一次被震驚：“孩子和馬超都死了？”
    “娘娘太可憐了……”藍香悲傷地哭著，哭著哭著她拉住包拯的手，吃驚地說：“你要……帶娘娘出宮？不行，娘娘會死的，他們……他們也會殺了你的……”
    “楚珠帶李妃出宮了？”包拯和公孫策同時驚問道。
    “藥……”藍香像是沒聽見，又著急地在身邊翻找起來，她抱起床上的小被子，一把推到包拯手裡：“給你……我剛剛在太醫院拿了很多治療外傷的藥，給娘娘的……都拿去吧……”
    “藍香，楚珠把娘娘帶出宮了嗎？”包拯問。
    “她們走了……藍香再也見不到她們了……”藍香流著淚說，她望著門口，像是看著誰在離去。雖然她的樣子還是很害怕，但臉上卻微微笑了。這一刻，透過她又老又瘦的臉，包拯好像看到了她年輕時的樣子，那是一個膽小瘦弱但又善良的女孩的樣子。
    包拯深吸一口氣問：“藍香，你為什麼沒有和她們一起走？”
    藍香連忙搖頭：“太可怕了，不能走，不能走……”
    包拯卻明白了，他握著她的手，緩緩地說：“你是擔心如果你走了，壞人可能會發現不對，你擔心他們來找你，你怕連累娘娘，怕他們發現娘娘還活著，所以你沒有走，對嗎？但是這麼多年你一個人孤獨地留在這兒，每天在害怕和擔心中度過，不敢說，也不敢問，時間長了你也會生病的。現在你就好好休息吧，事情都交給我，我來處理，我會找到娘娘和楚珠的，你放心吧！”
    藍香望著包拯，好像終於看清了面前的人，她問：“你是誰？”
    “我是包拯，請相信我，你的苦不會白受，當年的事情也會真相大白的。”包拯慢慢地、溫和地說。
    藍香好像聽懂了。她點了點頭，閉上眼睛，安心地睡著了。
    包拯和公孫策從屋子裡退了出來。門外天空暗沉，樹葉飛舞，寒涼的風聲和樹葉撞擊門窗的聲音都透著破敗和冷清。他們站在院子裡，風吹起了他們的衣服，也吹亂了他們的頭髮。
    “現在有兩個人證了，王鐵和藍香，他們都看到過張懷殺人。”公孫策說。
    “走，抓張懷！”包拯說。

sentences.english: It seemed like Lan Xiang understood. She nodded, closed her eyes, and fell asleep peacefully.

sentences.simplified: 包拯和公孙策从屋子里退了出来。
sentences.traditional: 包拯和公孫策從屋子裡退了出來。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng hé gōng sūn cè cóng wū zi lǐ tuì le chu lai
sentences.english: Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce stepped out of the house.

sentences.simplified: 门外天空暗沉，
sentences.traditional: 門外天空暗沉，
sentences.pinyin: mén wài tiān kōng àn chén
sentences.english: Outside the door, the sky was dark and gloomy.

sentences.simplified: 树叶飞舞，寒凉的风声和树叶撞击门窗的声音都透着破败和冷清。
sentences.traditional: 樹葉飛舞，寒涼的風聲和樹葉撞擊門窗的聲音都透著破敗和冷清。
sentences.pinyin: shù yè fēi wǔ hán liáng de fēng shēng hé shù yè zhuàng jī mén chuāng de shēng yīn dōu tòu zhe pò bài hé lěng qīng
sentences.english: Leaves were swirling, and the sound of the cold wind and leaves hitting the doors and windows conveyed a sense of decay and desolation.

sentences.simplified: 他们站在院子里，风吹起了他们的衣服，也吹乱了他们的头发。
sentences.traditional: 他們站在院子裡，風吹起了他們的衣服，也吹亂了他們的頭髮。
sentences.pinyin: tā men zhàn zài yuàn zi lǐ fēng chuī qǐ le tā men de yī fu yě chuī luàn le tā men de tóu fa
sentences.english: They stood in the courtyard, the wind lifting their clothes and messing up their hair.

sentences.simplified: “现在有两个人证了，王铁和蓝香，他们都看到过张怀杀人。”公孙策说。
sentences.traditional: “現在有兩個人證了，王鐵和藍香，他們都看到過張懷殺人。”公孫策說。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài yǒu liǎng ge rén zhèng le wáng tiě hé lán xiāng tā men dōu kàn dào guò zhāng huái shā rén gōng sūn cè shuō
sentences.english: “Now we have two witnesses, Wang Tie and Lan Xiang. They both saw Zhang Huai kill people,” Gongsun Ce said.

sentences.simplified: “走，抓张怀！”包拯说。
sentences.traditional: “走，抓張懷！”包拯說。
sentences.pinyin: zǒu zhuā zhāng huái bāo zhěng shuō
sentences.english: “Let’s go and arrest Zhang Huai!” Bao Zheng said.

sentence_translations: Chapter 25: Bao Zheng’s Promise
After a while, Lan Xiang woke up.
She was extremely tired, her voice faint and weak. She looked at Bao Zheng and asked, “Chu Zhu … how did you get back?”
Bao Zheng did not answer. He didn’t know how to respond.
But Lan Xiang seemed to have heard his answer and started crying agitatedly:
“What did you say? The child … is dead? Ma Chao is also dead?”
Bao Zheng was shocked again: “Both the child and Ma Chao are dead?”
“The noble consort is so pitiful …” Lan Xiang cried sorrowfully.
As she cried, she grabbed Bao Zheng’s hand, and said in shock, “You … you want to take the noble consort out of the palace?
Out of the question, the noble consort will die, and they … they will kill you too …”
“Chu Zhu took Consort Li out of the palace?” Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce asked in shock at the same time.
“Medicine …” Lan Xiang, as if she hadn’t heard, anxiously started searching around her.
She picked up the small quilt on the bed and pushed it into Bao Zheng’s hands:
“Here … I just got a lot of medicine for treating external injuries from the Imperial Academy of Medicine.
It’s for the noble consort … take it to her …”
“Lan Xiang, did Chu Zhu take the noble consort out of the palace?” Bao Zheng asked.
“They’ve left … Lan Xiang will never see them again …” Lan Xiang said through her tears.
She was looking at the door, as if watching someone leave.
Although she still looked scared, a faint smile appeared on her face.
At this moment, through her old and thin face, ..
.. Bao Zheng seemed to see what she looked like when she was young—a timid, frail, yet kind-hearted girl.
Bao Zheng took a deep breath and asked, “Lan Xiang, why didn’t you leave with them?”
Lan Xiang quickly shook her head: “It’s too terrible, I couldn’t leave, I couldn’t leave …”
Bao Zheng understood.
Holding her hand, he slowly said, “You were worried that if you left, the bad people might notice something was wrong.
You worried that they would come looking for you, and you feared getting the noble consort in trouble.
You were afraid they’d find out that the noble consort was still alive, so you didn’t leave, right?
But all these years, you’ve stayed here alone, living every day in fear and worry, not daring to speak or ask questions.
Over time, you also got sick.
Now, you should rest well. Leave everything to me. I will handle it. I will find the noble consort and Chu Zhu. Rest assured!”
Lan Xiang looked at Bao Zheng, as if finally seeing the person in front of her clearly. She asked, “Who are you?”
“I am Bao Zheng. Please believe me, your suffering will not be in vain.
The truth about what happened in the past will be revealed.” Bao Zheng spoke slowly and gently.
It seemed like Lan Xiang understood. She nodded, closed her eyes, and fell asleep peacefully.
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce stepped out of the house.
Outside the door, the sky was dark and gloomy.
Leaves were swirling, and the sound of the cold wind and leaves hitting the doors and windows conveyed a sense of decay and desolation.
They stood in the courtyard, the wind lifting their clothes and messing up their hair.
“Now we have two witnesses, Wang Tie and Lan Xiang. They both saw Zhang Huai kill people,” Gongsun Ce said.
“Let’s go and arrest Zhang Huai!” Bao Zheng said.
